name: Thai Red Tofu Curry with Jasmine Rice

components.name: Thai Red Tofu Curry

ingredients.name: Medium firm tofu from package, cut into cubes
THAI RED CURRY PASTE certified vegetarian with NO shrimp paste

steps: Confirm the red curry paste has no fermented shrimp, fish or meat extracts, and soy sauce is vegetarian.
Heat half the coconut milk in a saucepan and simmer a few minutes; add vegetarian curry paste and stir until fragrant.
Stir in remaining coconut milk, water, mushrooms, bamboo shoots and tofu. Simmer 10 minutes before adding sliced peppers.
Season with soy sauce, sugar and lime; fold through Thai basil off heat.
Pack rice and curry separately; tofu can become spongier if frozen, so test freezer acceptability before publishing.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Cook washed jasmine rice in the measured water.
